ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles

input.comment: [Playbook] We changed the governing law in Section 28.1 from Singapore to New York, which is our standard position, and removed the conflicting grant of exclusive jurisdiction to the Singapore courts so that the exclusive venue provision in Section 28.2 (New York County) governs. If New York is not workable, we can accept Delaware or California law and courts, or England and Wales with the courts of London.
input.summary: Replace Singapore governing law and venue with New York law, leaving New York County courts as the exclusive forum.
